items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: I contacted Wilbur, and we played the Monday and Tuesdays.

ctx.x: Yes. He had just got his discharge from the service, so he comes and he says, "Who do you have on the piano, Wilbur?" And I said, "Jodie, you can have it." And I was thinking in the back of my mind that we could make it. So I started that month ... so I would go on Monday and Tuesdays down there, but that was (unintelligible) and George and Brownie ... Brownie said, "Man, I like your playing; come on by the hotel." Well, naturally George Morrow and I hung out -- bass players, and I contacted Wilbur, and we played…
The next group to come in -- well, it wasn't a group so what Sol was doing, we were working the off nights, the trio -- rhythm section; piano, bass and drum, and here comes Themonius.
